in_hindi.name: भगवती
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sarvashakti (Omnipotent) + Maan (Mother) = Bhagwati (Mother of All Power)

in_tamil.name: பகவத்யி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Aathma (Soul) + Athavar (Mother) = Bhagwati (Mother of the Soul)

in_telugu.name: భగ్వతీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Dheshini (Goddess of Wealth) + Dheshiya (Goddess of Wealth's Lord) = Bhagwati (Goddess of Wealth's Goddess)

in_marathi.name: Bhagwati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagwati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagwati is a Sanskrit word that means 'Goddess of Fortune'. She is also known as Bhagavati and Bhagamalini. In Hindu mythology, Bhagwati is an aspect of the goddess Durga and is often depicted as a beautiful, graceful woman with multiple arms holding various symbols of abundance and prosperity. She is the giver of boons and blesses her devotees with wealth, happiness, and good fortune.
